kind: Offline public-sample depth rebake screen and reference-depth diagnostic. No shipping asset, runtime model, rendered quality, or phone-cost change.
decision: Cut: flat-depth and order warnings regress. Lower mean reference AbsRel also hides four RMSE regressions and 23 newly unscored pixels. No replacement model or baked depth asset ships.

settings.input: Original browser-decoded RGB, resized with Lanczos. Official masked inverse depth; invalid depth maps to zero. Bilinear resize to original model dimensions. Built-ins are packed and unpacked with the existing unsigned-16-bit format before the field screen.

summary.interpretation: Optimistic feasibility bounds only; not a deployed input-specific selection policy. Thirty added photos keep their original inference. References are excluded from the selected warning class.
